financial_invariants_verified: ACCOUNT_STATUS: CLOSED if !is_active or no history; DORMANT if days >= 365; else ACTIVE
AVERAGE_BALANCE: sum/count with ROUND_HALF_UP, empty returns 0
CASH_FLOW_RATE: net_flow / days with ROUND_HALF_UP, days must be positive
DAYS_SINCE_ACTIVITY: ref_date - last_activity_date, non-negative, raises if future
IS_DORMANT: days >= threshold (default 365), threshold must be non-negative
BALANCE_TREND: IMPROVING if closing > opening, DECLINING if <, STABLE otherwise
ACCOUNT_METRICS: composed from net_flow, cash_flow_rate, is_dormant
